summary: Verified both P0 fixes with a new pytest suite (12/12 passing). (1) All 4 /api/insights/* endpoints now reject unauthenticated calls with success=false, error='Authentication required.' and no data payload; authenticated admin calls still return success=true with data (backward compatible). (2) /api/analytics/forecast/overview unauth now returns HTTP 401; authenticated fresh=1 returns kpi+buy_list; /forecast/season returns rows, past_start (ISO string), festival_calendar. (3) Concurrency test: while forecast overview fresh=1 was computing, 5 concurrent /api/health calls all returned 200 with max latency well under 10s, proving the event loop is no longer blocked (asyncio.to_thread + per-key single-flight lock working).
critical_code_review_comments: insights.py: _ensure_tenant / _build_query guard pattern is correctly applied at all 4 endpoints — unauth path returns wrapped APIResponse (200 body, success=false) which matches the app's existing convention. Consider unifying with true 401 like /analytics/forecast/overview for stricter REST semantics, but current behavior is safe (no data leak).
forecast.py: asyncio.to_thread + per-key asyncio.Lock single-flight is correctly implemented; event-loop non-blocking behavior verified under concurrent load.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_p0_security_and_concurrency.py covers P0 auth guards on 4 insights endpoints + forecast overview/season + event-loop non-blocking check. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set. Admin tenant currently has 0 SKUs so forecast compute is fast (~2s); concurrency assertion (health<10s) is loose to accommodate future data growth — tighten if needed.
